mechanism_summary: Two DIFFERENT things are happening in the evidence table the campaign brief supplied, not one continuum: (1) 2023-06-30, 2023-09-30 and 2023-12-31 (the 3 pre-IPO quarters) hold Interest Income in the revS slot instead of Total revenue from operations -- confirmed OURS_WRONG, gap = fees + net FV gain + net gain on derecognition, to the cent, in every quarter checked. These 3 quarters were populated pre-IPO via scripts/screener_prerev.py (a Screener scraper that pulls a table row literally labelled 'Sales'/'Revenue' from screener.in and anchors it only on PAT match -- the row-selection bug is upstream of that anchor, so a wrong revenue row silently passed a PAT-only gate). (2) From 2024-03-31 onward (i.e. once the company was equity-listed and results began flowing through the standard post-listing BSE/NSE pipeline instead of the pre-IPO Screener scrape) the stored revS is the CORRECT Total-revenue-from-operations row, confirmed exact at both 2024-06-30 and the 2025-09-30 control -- the residual ~1.6-2.7% 'gaps' reported for the 2024 quarters in the brief are a std-vs-con basis artifact (Screener's default page shows consolidated; our own con slot for 2024-06-30 already holds the exactly-right 713.14) and are NOT the same defect as the 2023 quarters.
